questions.q: What is a work area in Oracle Fusion applications?
options: A role-based landing page grouping the tasks relevant to a job
A physical location where assets are stored
questions.explain: Work areas replace a single flat menu with role-based landing pages tailored to what a particular job actually needs to do.

questions.q: Which work area is used to define asset books, categories, and locations?
questions.explain: Configuration objects like books, categories, locations, and calendars are defined in the Setup and Maintenance work area, shared across Fusion Financials.

options: A manual task that can never be automated
The same job as a manual task, but run automatically on a recurring schedule
A report that only runs once per year
questions.explain: Many tasks, like Calculate Depreciation, have a scheduled-process twin that runs the same job automatically on a cadence instead of a manual click.

questions.q: Why does Oracle Fusion Assets restrict certain tasks like period close to specific job roles?
options: To slow down the accounting close process
Because period close requires a different work area
Because only managers can log in to the system
questions.explain: Tying tasks to specific job roles is how the application enforces segregation of duties — the person adding an asset isn't necessarily the one who can close the period.

questions.q: Which of these is a periodic processing task inside the Fixed Assets work area?
questions.explain: Calculate Depreciation (often called Run Depreciation) is a periodic processing task, run once per period for a given book.
